title: Executive OKR to Team Initiative Heatmap & Alignment Playbook
creator: Asha Menon
description: Create a repeatable, cross-functional heatmap and playbook that maps company-level OKRs to team-level initiatives and individual owners. This ticket covers the artifacts, alignment workshops, measurement plan, and tracking dashboard to ensure every engineering, design, and product initiative has an explicit contribution to one or more company OKRs. Deliverables: 1) an OKR-to-initiative heatmap CSV + visual dashboard, 2) a one-page alignment playbook (roles, cadence, escalation), 3) RACI for top 12 initiatives, 4) dashboard queries and alerts for regressions, 5) workshop materials for exec -> team syncs.
acceptance_criteria: Heatmap artifact exists and is accessible in Drive with columns: OKR, Initiative, Team, Owner, Priority, Confidence, Start, End, Metrics
Playbook doc published with: cadence for syncs, escalation path, decision rules for re-prioritization, and a two-week rollout checklist
RACI created for the top 12 company initiatives and reviewed by Eng, Design, and GTM leads
Dashboard shows OKR rollup metrics (progress %, leading indicators) and has at least 2 alert rules for regressions
All relevant teams (Engineering, Product, Design, Ops) have confirmed owners in the heatmap and attended an alignment workshop
updates: 2025-01-09 - Kickoff: scoped deliverables with Mira (VP Product) and Marcus (Head of Eng). Identified top 12 initiatives from PM triage; confirmed dependencies on ENG-4812 (telemetry schema) and DES-212 (visual heatmap template).
2025-01-21 - Draft heatmap template created and stored at Drive: /Company/OKRs/2025/Q1/heatmap-draft.csv. Shared with Design for visual polish. Asked Eng to confirm metric availability by 2025-01-24.

2025-01-28 - Workshop #1 (Exec->Leads) ran. Key decisions: treat Dedicated capacity roadmap as a single initiative with sub-initiatives; assign temporary OKR confidence tags (high/medium/low). Action: create RACI draft for top 12 by 2025-02-03.
2025-02-03 - RACI draft complete. Feedback from Design: include "Impact on Latency SLOs" column. Updated heatmap to include technical risk and estimated effort (points).

2025-02-10 - Dashboard prototype in Looker linked to telemetry namespace 'okrs.rollup'. Queries validated by ENG; two alert rules proposed: (1) weekly progress delta < -5% (2) leading indicator drop > 10% for two weeks.

2025-02-14 - Playbook v0.1 published at Confluence: /wiki/OKR-Playbook. Circulated for comments. PMs requested clearer decision rule for re-prioritization between Dedicated and Runtime performance investments.
2025-02-18 - Alignment workshop #2 (Teams): majority of teams confirmed owners. Found 3 initiatives missing reliable leading indicators -> flagged as remediate-by-ENG-4812. Updated dependencies list.
2025-02-19 - Ready for final review with Exec (Mira, Noah, Marcus) on 2025-02-21. Target to close ticket after dashboard wiring and final approvals by 2025-02-28.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Key initiatives lack reliable leading indicators -> Mitigation: ENG to add telemetry events (ENG-4812) and PMs to define proxy metrics
Risk: Misalignment on prioritization between performance (runtime) and Dedicated product -> Mitigation: run quant trade-off session and publish decision rules in playbook
Risk: Dashboard data lag or schema mismatch -> Mitigation: add validation queries and fallbacks; include 'confidence' column in heatmap
next_steps: Finalize dashboard wiring and alert rules (owner: Analytics) by 2025-02-24
Incorporate Exec feedback in playbook and heatmap on 2025-02-21 review
Coordinate two follow-up 30m syncs per quarter: Exec->Leads and Leads->Teams (added to playbook cadence)
Close ticket after final approvals and move artifacts into Company OKRs canonical folder
